 PETALING JAYA: A landslide was reported near a housing area along Persiaran Kosmos, Section U5, Shah Alam on Wednesday (Nov 11).
 Selangor Fire and Rescue Department assistant operations director Ashrul Riezal Ashbar said the department received an emergency call at 9.55am before a team from the Sungai Buloh Fire and Rescue Station arrived at the scene at 10.12am.
 He said an initial assessment found that the landslide did not involve any casualties.
 "Firefighters monitored the scene to ensure there was no danger to members of the public.
 "The case was subsequently handed over to the Shah Alam City Council (MBSA) for further action," he said when contacted.
 A total of four firefighters and one Fire Rescue Tender (FRT) were deployed to the scene.
